description.it: Libri non restituiti dopo la scadenza, per classe (i docenti in fondo), con i giorni di ritardo.
description.en: Books not returned after the due date, by class (teachers last), with the days late.

sql: SELECT pc.class_label AS class, p.last_name || ' ' || p.first_name AS patron, p.patron_type AS patron_type, b.title AS title, l.due_date AS due, CAST(julianday(:today) - julianday(l.due_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_late FROM loan l JOIN patron p ON p.id = l.patron_id LEFT JOIN patron_class pc ON pc.patron_id = p.id JOIN item i ON i.id = l.item_id JOIN biblio b ON b.id = i.biblio_id WHERE l.returned_at IS NULL AND l.due_date < :today AND julianday(:today) - julianday(l.due_date) >= :minDays ORDER BY CASE pc.group_kind WHEN 'students' THEN 0 WHEN 'teachers' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, pc.level_position, pc.group_name, p.last_name, p.first_name, l.due_date
